text: This app is simple yet perfect. It has all the features I need without a bunch of clutter. Tried a whole bunch of habit tracker apps before settling with this one. The developer is also incredible, listening to their users! Absolutely nothing to complain about. Just get this app if you need to track your habits easily yet beautifully and with motivation!!
author: Eveline Kjellquist
developer_reply: Wow, thank you so much for such a thoughtful review! It means the world to hear that Habits stood out after you tried so many others. I’ve worked hard to keep the 'clutter' out so you can focus on what matters—your progress. Thanks for being part of the community and for the incredible support!
